messages.text: Hi all, quick announcement: we're moving off the old spreadsheet-and-email expense process. Starting Monday 2026-07-06 all expense reports go through the new tool. You'll get an invite to your firm email this afternoon. Login is through SSO, so no new password.
Nice, finally. Does it handle receipt photos from your phone or do we still have to scan everything?
Phone photos work fine. There's a mobile app and you can also forward receipts to a dedicated inbox, it'll match them to the line items automatically.
Question on cutover: what happens to reports I've already started in the old template for June? Do I resubmit them in the new tool or finish them the old way?
Good one. Anything for June expenses, submit through the old process by Friday 2026-07-10. Anything incurred July 1 or later goes in the new tool only. Please don't double submit.
Got it, thanks. I'll clear my June stuff this week then.
Will there be a training session? Some of us on the client side travel a lot and I'd rather not figure out per diem rules by trial and error.
Yes, two 30 minute walkthroughs, Thursday 2026-07-02 at 11:00 and Friday at 15:00. Recordings will be posted afterward. Per diem and mileage rules are baked in, so it'll flag anything out of policy.
Does anyone know if the approval routing follows the old chain? My manager approves, then finance?
Same chain: direct manager first, then finance review. Anything over $2,500 gets a second sign-off from the department head. The tool routes it automatically.
Is the corporate card feed connected? Last tool we had, I spent half my time matching transactions by hand.
Yes, card transactions will import daily and show up as drafts for you to attach receipts to. Reimbursements for out-of-pocket spend should land in about 5 business days after approval.
Perfect, I'll book the Thursday one. Thanks Martin.
Heads up, my invite just landed. Login worked first try with SSO, the dashboard looks pretty clean.
Same here. Only gripe is the category list is long, took me a minute to find client entertainment vs. meals.
Fair point, I'll pass that along to the vendor. There's a favorites option so you can pin the categories you use most. Please drop other questions here and I'll keep a running FAQ.
